premise: Lying in the grass, Acorn sees a tree in the clouds, Bee sees a flower, and Caterpillar sees a butterfly: her own wish.
inspiration: Folk cloud-watching and Andersen's wishing, turned: each friend sees the thing they hope for, and the others promise to wait for it with her.

en-US.title: Cloud Shapes
en-US.text: {canvas:clouds 0.7 50s} {sfx:breeze} It was a lazy, cloudy afternoon. {acorn:enter} Acorn and {caterpillar:enter} Caterpillar lay in the grass, and {bee:enter} {bee:float loop 0.3} Bee came buzzing by. [curious] What can you see? asked Bee. {acorn:face happy} Acorn pointed. That one looks like a tree! A big oak. {acorn:live} She clasped her hands, closed her eyes tight and wished… then threw up her arms and bounced. One day! {bee:face happy} [giggles] That one looks like a flower! said Bee. {bee:live} She hummed a happy tune with her eyes closed, and did a little wiggly dance. Caterpillar didn't say a word. {caterpillar:live hold} She reared up tall and gazed at one small cloud with two round wings. {acorn:face surprised} [softly] What's that one? asked Acorn. [whispers] A butterfly, said Caterpillar. {caterpillar:glow} Maybe one day, that will be me. [happily] {bee:hearts} {acorn:face happy} We'll wait for it with you, said her friends. {caterpillar:live resume} Caterpillar came down again and wiggled happily. {caterpillar:face happy} And they watched the clouds drift by, together, all afternoon.

es-ES.title: Formas de nubes
es-ES.text: {canvas:clouds 0.7 50s} {sfx:breeze} Era una tarde tranquila y nublada. {acorn:enter} Bellota y {caterpillar:enter} Oruga estaban tumbadas en la hierba blandita, mirando arriba, y {bee:enter} {bee:float loop 0.3} Abeja llegó zumbando. [curious] ¿Qué veis?, preguntó Abeja. {acorn:face happy} Bellota señaló. ¡Esa parece un árbol! Un roble grande y alto. {acorn:live} Juntó las manitas, cerró los ojos con fuerza y pidió un deseo… y luego levantó los brazos y dio un saltito. ¡Algún día! {bee:face happy} [giggles] ¡Esa parece una flor!, dijo Abeja. {bee:live} Tarareó una canción alegre con los ojos cerrados, y bailó meneándose. Oruga no decía nada. {caterpillar:live hold} Se estiró bien alta y miró una nube pequeñita con dos alas redondas. {acorn:face surprised} [softly] ¿Y esa qué es?, preguntó Bellota. [whispers] Una mariposa, dijo Oruga. {caterpillar:glow} A lo mejor un día seré yo. [happily] {bee:hearts} {acorn:face happy} Esperaremos contigo, dijeron sus amigas. {caterpillar:live resume} Oruga bajó otra vez y se meneó contenta. {caterpillar:face happy} Y se quedaron mirando las nubes pasar, juntas, toda la tarde.

breeze.prompt: a soft summer breeze over a grassy meadow with distant birds
